exposure: Intraoperative hemorrhage group vs. no intraoperative hemorrhage group
size of the defect resulting from myoma enucleation
outcome: Causes of intraoperative hemorrhage during cesarean myomectomy
cohort: 102 women who underwent cesarean myomectomy (36 with intraoperative hemorrhage and 66 without)
finding: The study found that larger myoma size and longer surgery duration were significantly associated with intraoperative hemorrhage during cesarean myomectomy.
mod_finding: Cesarean myomectomy itself was identified as a risk factor for hemorrhage, and larger myoma size was associated with increased risk.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was recorded but not found to be significantly different between groups.
